Title: Read-side query splitting and performance hardening
Purpose: Split broad query logic into focused projection/query services and reduce unnecessary in-memory aggregation or full-graph loading for common read surfaces.
Deliverables: Focused query/projection services for definition list, editor load, run detail, analytics, or equivalent read seams.
Reduced avoidable broad-load and in-memory aggregation patterns in the common read paths.
Proof that read-side behavior stayed correct after the split.
ReviewQuestions: Did the read-side work actually reduce broad-load assumptions?
Did we keep the query layer projection-only?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If the query split is superficial or still dominated by broad loads, trigger the runtime/query corrective playbook before consolidation and UI work begins.
